name: Trade Transaction Status And Reason 1
definition: Identifies the transaction with a trade reference and provides its status. If the status is rejected, a reason for this status must be given.

RelatedReference.name: Related Reference
RelatedReference.definition: Provides the identification of the RegulatoryTransactionReport document that was previously sent by the reporting institution.

TradeReference.name: Trade Reference
TradeReference.definition: Unique identification assigned to a trade once it is received or matched by an executing system.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Indicates the status of a trade transaction.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Indicates that the report is rejected and provides a reason why.

TypeOfStatusRule.definition: Either Status or Rejected must be present, but not both.
